title: clearCache
summary: Clear the cache and counters for one MemoizedFunction object.

tested.integration: clearCache resets shared MemoizedFunction cache counters

description: `clearCache(memoizedFcn)` removes all cached entries for a `MemoizedFunction` object and resets `TotalHits` and `TotalMisses` to zero.
behaviors: The input must be a `MemoizedFunction` object returned by `memoize`.
Cache state is shared per wrapped function, so clearing one object also clears other memoized handles for the same function.
The operation returns zero internally and suppresses automatic output in statement form.
Object properties such as `Function`, `Enabled`, and `CacheSize` are preserved.

faqs.question: Does `clearCache` delete the MemoizedFunction object?
faqs.answer: No. It only clears cache entries and counters.

faqs.question: Does it affect other functions?
faqs.answer: No. Use `clearAllMemoizedCaches` to clear every memoized-function cache.
